semiconductor_relevance: High — Sico Technology specializes in high-purity silicon products and components essential for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Sico Technology GmbH is a high-tech company that develops and manufactures high-purity silicon products, as well as ceramic and quartz components, for the semiconductor industry. With a focus on innovative production methods, they provide unique solutions such as a silicon injector that enhances operational efficiency and chip yields.
capabilities: High-purity silicon injectors for semiconductor production

regional_presence.Austria: Headquartered in Bad Bleiberg, Austria, with a strong manufacturing presence.
regional_presence.Singapore: Operates in Singapore, serving the semiconductor market in Asia.
regional_presence.United States: Has a presence in the USA to support its international customer base.
